story_title: Sqlsure Tries To Catch SQL Bugs Before Production

story_identity.one_sentence_story: Sqlsure is a static-analysis project designed to catch SQL query errors before deployment.
story_identity.why_it_matters: Database mistakes can become expensive production failures when they are discovered late.

records.title: Sqlsure static analysis benchmark
records.summary: Sqlsure checks SQL queries during development and reports a small benchmark of detection and repair behavior.
records.description: The project positions itself as an early warning system for SQL query mistakes.
records.content: Sqlsure analyzes each query in approximately 0.1 ms. In a benchmark of 2,568 queries, it flagged 45 issues with zero false alarms. The project identified an 8x performance bug in one query. Its repair mode fixed 10 out of 10 broken examples in the published test. These are project-reported benchmark results rather than an independent guarantee that every production query will be correct.
